text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Aston Machan and Vodka suffered 
defeat. However, Vodka drew the crowd's 
spotlight with an unexpectedly brilliant 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet, too, is stunned by her 
commanding performance, which leaves 
everyone full of anticipation for what's 
next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan predicted the two would 
create a huge buzz. Calculating her own 
unique way to stand out, she chose the 
Fillies' Revue as her next goal.
